hashConvention.source: SHA256 UTF-8 after optional BOM removal and CRLF/CR to LF normalization, no trimming.
hashConvention.declaration: Exact Tree-sitter declaration/expression span excluding preceding XML comments/trailing whitespace.
hashConvention.signature: Start through block/arrow/accessor/lambda-body start, trailing whitespace removed.
hashConvention.body: Exact block, arrow expression, accessor list or lambda body bytes.

variables.N: Current direct-folder node count, no fixed folder cap.
variables.M: Largest retained collection/hash-table capacity; browser collections can retain largest visited-folder capacity across sources.
variables.T: Nodes in existing source-wide check index.
variables.S: Sum of current name/path searchable characters.
variables.B: Winning detached DDS bytes, representable int.MaxValue ceiling.
variables.C: Resident Shared cache entries, BMT<=2048 per source.
variables.F: Actual FLC picture blocks including ring, default<=4097.
variables.K: Actual palette allocations, including superseded palettes, charged1024 each.

constant.time: O(1) local scalar/reference work; delegated callbacks, lock waits and exception construction are additional.

text.time: O(L) formatting/concatenation and delegated localization/property notifications.
text.space: O(L) display strings, no source/pixel copy.

projection_init.time: O(Q) query inspection on an empty source; no source/file enumeration.
projection_init.space: O(Q) retained query and constant empty-controller references.

projection_folder.time: Expected O(N + S*Q) direct-child membership, eligibility and literal substring filtering; no recursion or I/O. Hash collision caveat applies.
projection_folder.space: O(N) arrays/reference sets; retained capacity can remain O(M), the largest visited folder.

projection_query.time: O(N + S*Q) conservative literal substring cost, or O(N+Q) for blank query; observers/layout additional.
projection_query.space: O(V) candidate visible references; original folder references remain retained; fixed two-field array per searched item.

visible.time: O(V) reference scan plus expected constant local membership gates where used.

check.time: Expected constant local gates plus existing shared leaf/ancestor check propagation up to tree height and notifications.
check.space: Local constant state plus delegated changed-ancestor notification storage.

release.time: O(M+N) reference collection clearing, row detachment/reset and delegated notifications.
release.space: Constant locals; capacity may remain O(M) until containing owner collection.

tile.time: O(L) metadata preparation and fixed subscription changes.
tile.space: O(L) display text plus fixed borrowed node/catalog/command references; no bitmap allocation here.

loader_init.time: Constant local configuration/registration; no persistent-storage I/O in construction.
loader_init.space: Constant wrapper/delegates before source start; later queue/cache/decoder costs separate.

loader_begin.time: Constant admission/captured-delegate creation plus Shared session startup; one source start per wrapper.
loader_begin.space: One original session closure and Shared bounded queue/cache; no extra source lease.

loader_request.time: Delegated Shared current/realization admission and queue/cache work; dictionary/LRU costs normally expected constant.
loader_request.space: Shared512 pending requests; BMT2048 memory entries/64MiB estimated bytes per source, excluding in-flight decode/native pixels.

loader_retire.time: Constant local await/identity work plus actual cancellation, active decoder/queue drain and cache release; no hard elapsed-time bound.
loader_retire.space: Existing worker/cache/source references retained through successful drain; failed result stays owned/observable.

gallery_init.time: Fixed subscriptions plus asynchronous existing settings initialization.
gallery_init.space: Constant retained control/language/task references; no thumbnail payload I/O.

settings.time: Path setup and delegated asynchronous settings read/accepted writes; filesystem latency unbounded here.
settings.space: Existing settings/controller/task storage; no new settings payload policy.

gallery_show.time: Projection cost plus expected O(N) adapters and O(N*L) aggregate text formatting; prior-folder O(M) cleanup; native notifications additional.
gallery_show.space: O(N) adapters/text and O(V) visible references; dictionary capacity can retain O(M) across sources.

gallery_sync.time: Expected O(V) node-to-adapter mapping/comparison and O(V) focus scan; at mostV add notifications when changed.
gallery_sync.space: O(V) temporary array and visible references; hidden current-folder adapters remain retained.

gallery_query.time: Projection filtering plus gallery synchronization/status costs; no source or preview replacement.
gallery_query.space: O(V) visible reference churn; full folder adapters/checks retained.

language.time: O(N*L) aggregate retained-row metadata refresh and notifications.
language.space: O(N*L) cumulative replacement string allocations; images/checks/focus retained.

gallery_dispose.time: Waits settings initialization/writes then presentation cleanup only after loader proof; callback/I/O latency delegated.
gallery_dispose.space: Constant task bookkeeping; failed loader deliberately retains gallery/source prerequisites.

attach_delta.time: Added loader/projection composition and gallery population; inherited source-wide tree/check indexing remains additive.
attach_delta.space: Added wrapper/projection/observer references and folder state; original snapshot lease reused.

close_delta.time: Added exact loader drain and gallery cleanup before inherited source release; native/decoder waits have no fixed latency.
close_delta.space: Original source lease/session/loader remains retained until all required local prerequisites succeed.

dispose_delta.time: Added clear-worker cancel/full-task drain, independent loader retirement, and gallery/settings disposal; inherited staged owner costs additive.
dispose_delta.space: Fixed added task references/stage-failure list; failed worker/native prerequisites remain retained locally.

observe.time: Constant local gated snapshot/arithmetic plus Shared registry statistics traversal; this BMT wrapper begins at mostone source. Constructor registration delegates existing registry participant/name traversal costs.
observe.space: Constant history/delegate state plus existing registry registration; no second cache, pixels or source lease.

trim.time: Constant local snapshot plus actual Shared eviction work O(C) worst-case for this one cache, subject to hash-table costs.
trim.space: Constant local state plus delegated session snapshot; returns actual estimated removed bytes.

observe_retire.time: Constant identity/zero-residency check and checked counter aggregation plus one actual statistics query.
observe_retire.space: Constant scalar history; drops callbacks only after successful exact-owner retirement.

flc_parse.time: Strict profile O(E + F*P +1024*K) controls, canvas writes/snapshots and ring comparison; legacy null-limit path retains inherited admission/costs.
flc_parse.space: Strict logical allowance charges5P working/futureRGBA, P per actual frame including ring and1024 per palette allocation. Default256MiB excludes object/list capacity, caller encoded storage and Shared/native retained sample copies.

flc_palette.time: Fixed256-entry palette work plus packet reads; strict mode requires full proven COLOR_256 semantics.
flc_palette.space: 1024-byte palette charged before creation; constant temporary state.

flc_full.time: O(encoded packet controls + P) checked strict RLE writes for one canvas.
flc_full.space: Constant helper state writing caller canvas; no new canvas here.

flc_delta.time: O(encoded controls/packets + bounded pixel writes) per strict frame; malformed/unknown controls decline.
flc_delta.space: Constant helper state; mutates only current owned canvas.

flc_video.time: O(P) synchronous conversion under decoder gate, cancellation per row and before cursor commit.
flc_video.space: One reusable4P RGBA buffer and constant result wrapper; retained Shared sample copies separate.

flc_position.time: Constant integer arithmetic/admission under gate; wait may include current O(P) conversion.
flc_position.space: Constant result/cursor state; absent audio writes no samples.

flc_dispose.time: Constant local transition after current conversion drains; optional input retirement awaited once outside gate with external latency.
flc_dispose.space: One terminal task/owner; local arrays released, failed/canceled input owner retained without implicit retry.

dds_render.time: O(H) original-tree walk + actual VFS read + optional O(B+L) key; hit reads/copies cached pixels, miss delegates DDS/scaler work.
dds_render.space: Winning detached B bytes plus optional64KiB key, inherited decoder/scaler output/workspace and returned thumbnail.64MiB persistence admission is not a read/decode heap cap.

dds_read.time: Delegated first-readable VFS resolution/read including failed upper-layer attempts; no hard I/O/cancellation latency introduced.
dds_read.space: Winning B-byte array, representable ceiling int.MaxValue, plus VFS workspace; no64MiB read cap or second read.

dds_decode.time: Inherited DDS/DDX decoder cost from encoded bytes and authored dimensions/mips; no new algorithm or bound.
dds_decode.space: Inherited decoder/output buffers; existing narrow failure policy retained.

dds_key.time: O(L) normalization/strict UTF-8 sizing and encoding plus O(B) hash only for B<=64MiB and complete key<=64KiB.
dds_key.space: Bounded identity stream/field/key copies and O(L) normalized strings; hashes the same winning source bytes.

dispatch_delta.time: Added constant DDS branch plus producer cost; otherwise unchanged texture/sprite decoder and scaler work.
dispatch_delta.space: No independent source/cache ownership; sprite companion/palette path remains inherited.

disk_clear.time: Delegated Shared optional initialization plus O(D) immediate file enumeration/deletion across16 shards, where D includes any extraneous files. Entry quotas do not bound arbitrary directory contents; no hard filesystem latency. Cancellation checked per shard/file.
disk_clear.space: Existing512MiB/16384-entry quota metadata plus streaming path strings and filesystem iterator state; directory scan count is separate from those quotas. No new cache implementation.

clear_start.time: Constant admission/task publication then existing asynchronous job start; concurrent repeated click declines.
clear_start.space: One published current completion/job; no storage I/O during UI construction.

clear_work.time: Delegated disk clear worker plus O(L) localized status/fixed UI changes; complete worker and continuation awaited.
clear_work.space: Constant operation/UI state plus Shared storage bookkeeping; source/preview/memory cache retained.

hashTableCaveat: Dictionary/HashSet estimates are expected/amortized. Worst-case collisions make a local operation O(N/M), or O(T) in existing source index; repeated outer operations multiply that work. No deterministic constant-time hashing claim.
costBoundary: Authored operations/allocations exclude arbitrary observers/native layout, allocator/GC overhead, filesystem latency and Shared/native retained copies. UI filtering has no fixed folder cap or measured latency here. Shared cache-clear quotas bound owned entries/storage, not extraneous files encountered by immediate enumeration.

ownershipReview: Snapshot/lease and original node/tile identity gate publication. Display labels, same paths in another source and recycled generations do not substitute ownership.

Local close waits native clear and exact thumbnail drain before releasing source fields/lease. Shutdown attempts thumbnail drain independently of native failure. Failed loader remains owned and observed.

Memory pressure queries/trims actual Shared caches outside observer gate; only successful zero-resident retirement transfers true counters to scalar history. Failed owner prevents replacement/unregistration.
Settings initialization and accepted writes are drained. Cache clear retains its full task before callbacks and is canceled/drained at shutdown, using the same application512MiB owner.

DDS64MiB gates only persistence after one actual winning VFS read. Oversized/incomplete identities decode uncached from those same bytes; key<=64KiB. No source payload persisted. Sprite companion path unchanged.

Strict FLC256MiB logical allocation budget includes working canvas/futureRGBA, every picture including ring and superseded palettes. Object/list overhead, caller encoded bytes, optional owner and Shared/native copies remain additional.

FLC input owner transfers only on constructor success. Synchronous gated conversion drains before one terminal asynchronous owner retirement; failed/canceled retirement retains owner and task without retry.
Legacy classic-video dispatch/timers remain unchanged. Later native playback and full sprite/artwork/poster/waveform/portrait persistence are not accepted by this slice.

findings.issue: Applied outer window/source prerequisite covers only Shadowkey NativeResourcesRetired. A failed thumbnail loader retained by AssetBrowser can still allow Explore BrowserSession and MainWindow graphics/localization/chrome/HWND disposal.
findings.evidence: AssetBrowser RetireGalleryLoaderAsync retains _loader after failure; DisposeGalleryAsync retains its view. Explore DisposeCoreAsync and MainWindow DisposeWindowOwnersAsync/CompleteCloseAsync consult native-only proof.
findings.qualification: Ordinary decode and cancellation-callback failures are caught by NewestFirstWorker; no common malformed-file trigger or runtime crash is claimed. The gap applies to a genuinely failed retained session/worker/observer retirement contract.
findings.proposal: Ignored gallery-retirement-window-20260921 patch adds separate WindowResourcesRetired = NativeResourcesRetired && _loader is null and uses it at outer prerequisites; review/source hashes in a separate receipt, not silently included here.

validation.scope: Source/AST/candidate composition only; source freezes/interrupted and resumed portable builds remain separate root evidence. No new build/test/GUI/performance result claimed.

remainingGates: Normal analyzer portable/Windows compilation and424+2 filtered cases on both runtimes.
Controlled worker/native/settings retirement failure injection; apply and validate outer prerequisite correction after freeze.
Persistent hit/invalidation/clear UI behavior and measured cost; full media/portrait/sprite cache work remains.
FLC native/GUI consumer acceptance and final publish/notices/native smoke/platform/release gates.
